node.statement: Node 1.2.2.1 establishes every premise of lem-maincb-reset-output-typing for this one scalar raw call: t_atom <= W.r_reset, epsilon_{U_1} <= t_atom, u_0 is an extended D_*t_atom-inclusion, its unit error is at most D_*t_atom, and u_0 is bijective. Instantiating that lemma with D=D_*, t=t_atom, epsilon_R=epsilon_{U_1}, B_R=M_1, and A_R=A_{U_1}, and choosing its one existential output v_{U_1}, yields in the same conclusion both required bounds, the unchanged source/target/amplification data, and extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism typing. No witness from lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation is used or identified with this witness.
